def ngpt_loss(student_logits, teacher_logits, temperature=1.0, alpha=0.5):
    hard_labels = teacher_logits.argmax(dim=-1)
    ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(student_logits.view(-1, student_logits.size(-1)), hard_labels.view(-1))
